tools.name: build_research_batch
tools.description: Assemble a representative batch of detections for agent research across multiple time windows and confidence bands. Use before probe tuning, archive investigations, or prompt refinement.

params.name: probe_id
params.desc: Optional probe ID to restrict the batch.

params.name: probe_name
params.desc: Optional human-readable probe name, resolved to probe_id internally.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional channel to restrict the batch.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Default window lower bound if periods are not provided. Default: 24.

params.name: until_hours
params.desc: Optional relative upper bound if periods are not provided.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound if periods are not provided.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound if periods are not provided.

params.name: periods
params.desc: Optional named time slices to sample independently.

params.name: bands
params.desc: Optional confidence bands for stratified sampling.

params.name: sort_by
params.desc: How to rank candidates before sampling within each period/band.

params.name: per_period_limit
params.desc: Max detections to keep per period before the final merge. Default: 24.

params.name: per_band_limit
params.desc: Max detections to keep per band inside each period. Default: 6.

params.name: max_candidates
params.desc: Max raw detections to scan per period before sampling. Default: 1000.

tools.name: calibrate_probe_from_archive
tools.description: Read-only CLIP P/N/M calibration for a proposed probe over archived frames. Use before creating/updating probes from VLM alerts, archive searches, or cross-channel sweeps. It scans real archived frames, compares a positive event query against a visible contrast query, suggests initial pos_floor/margin thresholds, and returns representative frames. Processes only a bounded channel batch per call and returns deferred_channel_ids for continuation.

params.name: event_query
params.desc: Positive visible event/action/state, e.g. 'two people fighting' or 'person lying on ground'.

params.name: positive_query
params.desc: Alias for event_query.

params.name: contrast_query
params.desc: Visible background/contrast state, e.g. 'people walking normally' or 'clear roadway with normal traffic'. Do not use literal negation.

params.name: negative_query
params.desc: Alias for contrast_query.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional single Luxriot channel ID.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: channel_ids
params.desc: Optional channel IDs to calibrate. The tool processes only the first max_channels_per_call and defers the rest.

params.name: sources
params.desc: Archive frame sources to scan. Default: ['vlm_alert','vlm_summary'].

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Scan frames from the past N hours. Default: 24.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: candidate_limit
params.desc: Max archive frames to scan per channel across sources. Default: 20000, max: 100000.

params.name: max_channels_per_call
params.desc: Max channels to process in this call. Default: 8, max: 8.

params.name: evidence_limit
params.desc: Representative frames per channel. Default: 8, max: 24.

params.name: min_frames
params.desc: Minimum archived frames before suggestions are considered reliable. Default: 8.

tools.name: count_video_summary_events
tools.description: Count appearance/disappearance style events from VLM video-summary text for one channel/time window. Use for questions like 'how many times did X appear/disappear', 'count entries/exits', or 'how often did an object leave/return'. The result is a structured count from summaries, with coverage and transition evidence; it is not frame-level ground truth.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID to query.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: entity_query
params.desc: Entity/object to track, e.g. 'person', 'white BMW', 'delivery courier', or 'animal'.

params.name: anchor_query
params.desc: Optional place/object relation, e.g. 'front door', 'loading bay', 'gate', or 'central square'.

params.name: event_kind
params.desc: Currently supports presence/absence transitions. Default: presence_transitions.

params.name: depth
params.desc: Summary level to scan. Use L1 for day-scale counts, live/L0 only for short exact windows.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Return summaries from the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Operator-relative range such as 'last 3 days'. The server resolves it against its current clock.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: run
params.desc: Optional run selector: latest, running, all, or a concrete run id.

params.name: level_limit
params.desc: Max nodes per rollup level to scan. Default: high bounded scan.

params.name: timeline_limit
params.desc: Max classified timeline rows to return. Default: 40, max: 120.

params.name: event_limit
params.desc: Max transition events to return. Default: 40, max: 120.

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Create a bookmark in Luxriot EVA on a camera channel, visible in the Luxriot client. Use to flag significant events for operator review. Only call when there is a concrete reason — do not create bookmarks speculatively.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel (camera) ID to attach the bookmark to.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: title
params.desc: Short bookmark title (max 80 characters).

params.name: description
params.desc: Detailed event description (max 240 characters).

params.name: severity
params.desc: Event severity level. Default: normal.

params.name: timestamp_ms
params.desc: Optional event timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to now.

tools.name: create_probe
tools.description: Create a new probe with text pairs and thresholds. Use CLIP-friendly generic visual descriptors, not private names or abstract logic. For VLM-alert follow-up, create one named probe per distinct visible event and use update_existing=true to avoid duplicates. IMPORTANT: model calls must use preview=true. The UI Apply button commits the returned action plan outside chat.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: positives
params.desc: Positive CLIP text prompts. Use visible object/action/state language such as 'two people fighting', 'vehicle doing a burnout', or 'person lying on ground'. Avoid personal names and legal/intent claims.

params.name: negatives
params.desc: Visible contrast/background states for P/N/M. Do not write literal negation such as 'no person', 'no vehicle', or 'without smoke'. Use positive alternatives such as 'clear sidewalk', 'parked vehicles on clear roadway', or 'people walking normally'.

params.name: update_existing
params.desc: If true, reuse an existing probe with the same name on the same channel instead of creating a duplicate. Default: true.

tools.name: delete_probes
tools.description: Delete one or more probes, or all probes. IMPORTANT: model calls must use preview=true. The UI Apply button commits the returned action plan outside chat.

params.name: probe_ids
params.desc: Optional explicit probe IDs to delete.

params.name: delete_all
params.desc: If true, delete all configured probes.

params.name: preview
params.desc: If true, return a deletion plan without applying. Default: true.

tools.name: deploy_summary
tools.description: Record the final outcome of a deployment or survey-only pass as a structured summary card. Use at the end of Protocol Deploy.

tools.name: describe_frame
tools.description: Send an image frame to the vision language model for a detailed description. Accepts a live camera snapshot (channel_id), a detection record (detection_id), or a filesystem path (image_path). Use to understand what is happening on camera right now, or to analyze a past detection.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID. Captures a live snapshot from the camera right now and describes it. Use when the operator asks about the current scene.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: image_path
params.desc: Absolute filesystem path to an image file.

params.name: detection_id
params.desc: Detection record ID. The stored thumbnail will be used.

params.name: prompt
params.desc: Optional instruction to the VLM. Defaults to a general scene description.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Compile an operator report for a time period. Defaults to live video-description coverage, VLM alerts, stream health, quiet channels, and evidence frames. Use report_type='probes' only when the operator explicitly asks for probe statistics.

params.name: report_type
params.desc: Default: video_descriptions. Use probes only for explicit probe reports.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Report covers data from the past N hours. Default: 24.

params.name: until_hours
params.desc: Optional upper bound. Omit for up-to-now.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted and normalized.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted and normalized.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds. Normalized to from_ts.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds. Normalized to to_ts.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional. Restrict report to one channel.

params.name: channel_ids
params.desc: Optional channel IDs for a multi-channel video-description report.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: include_probes
params.desc: Probe names to include when report_type='probes'.

params.name: top_events
params.desc: Include up to N representative evidence events. Default: 5.

tools.name: get_detection_summary
tools.description: Aggregate archive frame statistics grouped by archive item/probe. Returns counts, source labels, and latest activity timestamps. Use source=probe for actual probe detection summaries.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Summarize detections from the past N hours. Default: 24.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional. Restrict summary to one channel.

params.name: source
params.desc: Optional archive source filter: probe, vlm_summary, or vlm_alert.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: get_detections
tools.description: Retrieve recent archive frame records. By default this includes probe hits, video-description frames, and VLM alert frames. Use source=probe when you need actual probe detections only. Returns timestamps, source labels, scores where present, and preview image URLs.

params.name: probe_id
params.desc: Archive item/probe ID to filter by. If omitted, returns records across all archive items.

params.name: probe_name
params.desc: Human-readable probe name. Resolved to probe_id internally.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional. Restrict to archive records from this channel.

params.name: source
params.desc: Optional archive source filter. Use source=probe for real probe detections, source=vlm_summary for regular video-description frames, and source=vlm_alert for VLM alert frames.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Fetch detections from the past N hours. Default: 24.

params.name: until_hours
params.desc: Optional upper bound: detections older than N hours ago.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Pagination offset within the selected time window.

params.name: sort_by
params.desc: Order detections by event time. Default: newest.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Max detections to return. Default: 20, max: 100.

tools.name: get_prompt_settings
tools.description: Read the effective Luxriot VLM prompt settings. Without channel_id returns global defaults. With channel_id returns the effective per-channel view.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional Luxriot channel ID. Omit to read global defaults.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

tools.name: get_video_summaries
tools.description: Retrieve VLM-generated video summaries for a Luxriot channel. Returns narrative text summaries at different depths: live (L0, per-batch captions), L1 (minute-level), L2 (hour-level), L3 (day-level). Use to answer 'what happened on camera X in the last hour?' without re-analyzing frames.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID to query.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: depth
params.desc: live: raw per-batch captions (most detail, most entries). L1: minute-window rollups. L2: hour rollups. L3: day rollups. Default: L1.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Return summaries from the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Operator-relative range such as 'last 3 days'. The server resolves it against its current clock.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds.

params.name: run
params.desc: Optional run selector: latest, running, or a concrete run id.

params.name: level_limit
params.desc: Max nodes per rollup level to scan before slicing the requested depth. Defaults to a high bounded scan independent of display limit.

params.name: include_evidence_frames
params.desc: If true, also return representative archive frame records from source=vlm_summary and source=vlm_alert for the requested channel/time window. Use when the operator asks to confirm video-summary findings with images/snaps.

params.name: evidence_frame_limit
params.desc: Max evidence frames to include when include_evidence_frames=true. Default: 8, max: 24.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Max summary entries to return. Default: 20.

tools.name: get_video_summary_restore_status
tools.description: Get durable progress, ETA, current window, completed/restored/failed counts, and final report for the post-upgrade video-summary restoration worker.

tools.name: get_visual_window_signals
tools.description: Compare a positive and optional negative semantic phrase against CLIP-indexed video-description archive frames for one channel/time window. Returns P/N/M (positive score, negative score, margin) as an attention signal only, not proof. Use this to choose candidate windows/frames before calling describe_frame.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID to score.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title.

params.name: positive_query
params.desc: Visible-event phrase to look for, e.g. 'dog without visible ear tag'.

params.name: negative_query
params.desc: Optional contrast phrase, e.g. 'empty street with no dogs'.

params.name: sources
params.desc: Archive sources to compare. Default: ['vlm_alert','vlm_summary']; probe should be used only when the operator explicitly asks for probe corroboration.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Score frames from the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: limit_per_source
params.desc: Top results to inspect per query/source. Default: 8, max: 24.

params.name: candidate_limit
params.desc: Candidate pool before CLIP ranking. Default: 20000.

tools.name: list_attention_bursts
tools.description: List seconds whose measured motion ran far above the channel's own learned norm (capture_attention mode=burst) inside a time window. This is the FIRST tool for operator questions about spikes, sudden motion, 'что резкого было', or attention homeostasis: it is bounded and compact, unlike scanning full summaries. Bursts are statistical attention, not semantic proof - verify visually before alerting.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID to scan.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115' or a title.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Scan the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Operator-relative range such as 'last 3 days'. The server resolves it against its current clock.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds.

params.name: min_activity_x
params.desc: Only bursts at least this many times above the channel norm. Default: 0 (all bursts).

params.name: limit
params.desc: Max burst rows to return, strongest first. Default: 24, max: 100.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List available Luxriot channels with IDs and titles. Use before deployment, survey, or prompt tuning.

params.name: force
params.desc: If true, refresh channel list from Luxriot instead of relying on cache.

tools.name: list_probes
tools.description: List configured probes with their IDs, channels, thresholds, and recent hit counts.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Recent window used for hit counts. Default: 24.

tools.name: list_video_summary_channels
tools.description: Inventory which Luxriot channels have VLM video-summary coverage in a time window. Use this before broad video-description review when the operator did not name channels. Returns metadata, candidate channels, and runtime_problem_channels for stale/frozen/error/stopped live signal issues; not full summaries.

params.name: channel_ids
params.desc: Optional channel IDs to inspect. Omit to inspect all available authorized channels.

params.name: depth
params.desc: Summary level to count. Default: L1.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Return coverage from the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Operator-relative range such as 'last 3 days'. The server resolves it against its current clock.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted and normalized.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted and normalized.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds. Normalized to from_ts.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds. Normalized to to_ts.

params.name: run
params.desc: Optional run selector: latest, running, all, or a concrete run id.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Maximum candidate channels to return. Default: 16, max: 100.

params.name: runtime_only
params.desc: Return authoritative current stream runtime only, without historical coverage candidates.

tools.name: lookup_help
tools.description: Look up how to use EVA AI from its own operator/admin documentation: UI steps, workflows, scenario meaning, and product capabilities/limits. Use this for 'how do I...', 'where is...', 'what does X mean', and product-status questions; use top_k=8 for broad guide summaries. This is the agent's access path to first-party operator/admin docs, not internet browsing. NOT for incident facts about a scene. Returns documentation passages with citations. Admin/engineer-only matches come back as restricted_matches (no steps) when the caller lacks the permission; in that case tell the operator it is an admin/engineer action, do not invent the steps.

params.name: query
params.desc: What the operator wants to do or understand.

params.name: top_k
params.desc: Max passages to return (1-8, default 3).

tools.name: normalize_time_window
tools.description: Convert an operator-facing time range into exact Unix seconds/milliseconds. Use before archive or video-summary tools when the user gives relative or local times such as 'last day', 'last night from 1:30am to 8:30am', or 'past 90 minutes'.

params.name: date
params.desc: Optional local date in YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, day_hint is used.

params.name: day_hint
params.desc: How to choose the date when date is omitted. Default: today.

params.name: start_time
params.desc: Local start time, e.g. '01:30', '1:30am', or '23:00'.

params.name: end_time
params.desc: Local end time, e.g. '08:30', '8:30am', or '02:00'.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Optional relative range such as 'last week' (rolling 7 days), 'last day' (rolling 24h), 'last two hours', 'past 90 minutes', or 'last hour'. Prefer this for phrases like 'during the last two hours' or 'for the last week'.

params.name: timezone
params.desc: Optional IANA timezone supplied by the operator. Defaults to the neutral reference timezone ({AGENT_SITE_TIMEZONE}).

tools.name: prepare_probe_calibration_batch
tools.description: Stateful batch workflow for probe P/N/M calibration. Use instead of manually faning out calibrate_probe_from_archive when reviewing multiple probes, multiple VLM-alert classes, or multiple channels. The server holds the item list in a job and returns a compact decision ledger plus recommended create_probe/update_probe preview arguments. To continue, call again with job_id.

params.name: job_id
params.desc: Existing batch job id to continue.

params.name: items
params.desc: Optional event/probe items. If omitted, configured probes are used. Each item can include event_query, contrast_query, name/probe_name, probe_id, channel_id or channel_ids, severity, bookmark_enabled.

params.name: probe_names
params.desc: Optional configured probe names to calibrate when items are omitted.

params.name: items_per_call
params.desc: Max job items to process in this call. Default 4, max 8.

tools.name: restore_video_summary_history
tools.description: Preview a durable background job that restores missing semantic video-summary history from archived L0 batch text, then place it in the low-priority worker after UI approval. Use for post-upgrade requests such as 'restore missing summaries for all channels for two weeks'. Levels are fixed-duration semantic windows: L1=15 minutes, L2=60 minutes, L3=6 hours. Default recovery levels are L2 then L3, which rebuild the temporal lens quickly; include L1 only when the operator explicitly requests exhaustive 15-minute semantic backfill. The job is idempotent, survives restarts, yields to live VLM backlog, and reports ETA/progress/source gaps.

params.name: channel_ids
params.desc: Channels to restore. Omit for all authorized channels.

params.name: relative_range
params.desc: Relative period such as 'last two weeks' or 'last 14 days'.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: levels
params.desc: Levels to restore: L1=15 minutes, L2=60 minutes, L3=6 hours. Default: L2,L3. Add L1 only for exhaustive 15-minute history.

params.name: preview
params.desc: Must be true in chat. Returns an auditable UI Apply action.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Semantic text search over either an indexed folder (CLIP/FAISS) or the frame archive (vector search over probe hits and video-description frames). Returns ranked results with image URLs/previews, similarity scores, source labels, and metadata. When source is vlm_summary or vlm_alert, the result is from video descriptions, not a probe detection. TODO v1.1: add image_path/detection_id params for image-similarity search.

params.name: query
params.desc: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'person in red jacket near door'.

params.name: scope
params.desc: indexed_folder: searches a FAISS-indexed image directory. detections: searches the frame archive via stored CLIP vectors.

params.name: folder
params.desc: Required when scope=indexed_folder. Absolute path to an indexed folder.

params.name: probe_id
params.desc: Optional. When scope=detections, restrict to one archive item/probe id.

params.name: source
params.desc: Optional archive source filter. probe = probe hits/detections; vlm_summary = regular frames saved from video-description batches; vlm_alert = frames anchored to video-description alerts.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Optional. Restrict archive search to this channel.

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Only include results from the past N hours. Default: 24.

params.name: since_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: until_ms
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix milliseconds.

params.name: sort_by
params.desc: similarity: semantic relevance. time: newest first.

params.name: mode
params.desc: Frame archive search only. clip: fast/default. dino/fusion: richer visual matching when available.

params.name: candidate_limit
params.desc: Frame archive search only. Candidate pool before final ranking. Default: 20000.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Maximum results to return. Default: 12, max: 48.

tools.name: survey_channels
tools.description: Capture a short batch of snapshots from one or more channels over 10-15 seconds and summarize what each camera is looking at.

params.name: channel_ids
params.desc: Optional explicit list of channel IDs. Omit to survey all available channels.

params.name: fast_mode
params.desc: If true, use a shorter demo survey with fewer samples and less wait time.

params.name: duration_sec
params.desc: Approximate capture duration per channel. Default: 12 seconds.

params.name: sample_count
params.desc: How many snapshots to collect per channel. Default: 4.

params.name: prompt
params.desc: Optional instruction for the VLM summarizer.

tools.name: track_visual_state_transitions
tools.description: Track visual state changes over archived video-description frames using CLIP P/N/M signals. Use for unexpected/count questions such as 'how many times did X appear/disappear', 'when did a door open/close', or 'did an object leave/return'. Builds a timeline of stable visual state segments and returns boundary frame evidence. This is stronger than summary-text counts but still returns candidates, not legal/medical/intent conclusions.

params.name: channel_id
params.desc: Luxriot channel ID to query.

params.name: channel_ref
params.desc: Optional channel reference such as '#115', '115', or a title like 'stream'.

params.name: subject_query
params.desc: Optional subject label for reporting, e.g. 'delivery courier', 'white van', or 'animal'.

params.name: positive_state_query
params.desc: Visual state to count as positive, e.g. 'vehicle parked at gate' or 'person standing near doorway'.

params.name: negative_state_query
params.desc: Visible contrast state for CLIP scoring, e.g. 'empty gate' or 'empty doorway'. Avoid phrases like 'no person'/'without vehicle' when possible; literal negation is unreliable for CLIP.

params.name: alternate_state_query
params.desc: Optional third state, e.g. 'vehicle visible elsewhere, not at gate'.

params.name: positive_label
params.desc: State label for positive_state_query. Default: positive.

params.name: negative_label
params.desc: State label for negative_state_query. Default: negative.

params.name: alternate_label
params.desc: State label for alternate_state_query. Default: alternate.

params.name: sources
params.desc: Archive frame sources to scan. Default: ['vlm_summary','vlm_alert'].

params.name: since_hours
params.desc: Scan frames from the past N hours. Default: 6.

params.name: from_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute lower timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: to_ts
params.desc: Optional absolute upper timestamp bound in Unix seconds. Milliseconds are accepted.

params.name: candidate_limit
params.desc: Max archive frames to scan across sources. Default: 20000, max: 100000.

params.name: positive_floor
params.desc: Minimum positive CLIP score for the positive state. Default: 0.18.

params.name: negative_floor
params.desc: Minimum negative CLIP score for the negative state. Default: 0.18.

params.name: margin_threshold
params.desc: Minimum CLIP margin between winning state and runner-up. Default: 0.03.

params.name: min_state_samples
params.desc: Minimum samples for a stable segment. Default: 2.

params.name: min_state_duration_sec
params.desc: Minimum duration for a stable segment when sample count is low. Default: 2.

params.name: merge_gap_sec
params.desc: Merge short unknown gaps between same states. Default: 3.

params.name: transition_limit
params.desc: Max transitions to return. Default: 40, max: 120.

params.name: segment_limit
params.desc: Max segments to return. Default: 80, max: 200.

params.name: evidence_limit
params.desc: Max boundary evidence frames to return. Default: 24, max: 48.

tools.name: update_probe
tools.description: Modify a probe's configuration: text pairs (positives/negatives), detection thresholds, or enabled state. Use generic CLIP-visible wording; negatives are visible contrast states, not logical 'no X' clauses. IMPORTANT: model calls must use preview=true to show the user a diff. The UI Apply button commits the returned action plan outside chat.

params.name: probe_name
